attestations.note: The life page heads «Τύπος εορτής: Σταθερή. Εορτάζει στις 13 Ιουνίου εκάστου έτους», the same day as the listing, and carries no years. The entry names nobody and enumerates nobody, so it is one entry and not ten thousand folders; the page gives no place, no emperor and no judge. No asterisk and no «Δεν είναι διασταυρωμένη» sentence, and no hymn.
